pages.text: Kill a Minotaur with a Diamond Minotaur Axe to scavenge Tomahawk Smeak with a chance.

Kill a Minoshroom the same way to always get a Tomahawk Smeaxe. It is both a meal and a weapon: it swings like a tomahawk for 10 damage, but combat never wears it down. Each bite spends one use, and only a bone is left once it is finished.
